legend: Gildong has a square board consisting of n$$$n$$$ rows and n$$$n$$$ columns of square cells, each consisting of a single digit (from 0$$$0$$$ to 9$$$9$$$). The cell at the j$$$j$$$-th column of the i$$$i$$$-th row can be represented as (i,j)$$$(i, j)$$$, and the length of the side of each cell is 1$$$1$$$. Gildong likes big things, so for each digit d$$$d$$$, he wants to find a triangle such that:
Each vertex of the triangle is in the center of a cell.
The digit of every vertex of the triangle is d$$$d$$$.
At least one side of the triangle is parallel to one of the sides of the board. You may assume that a side of length 0$$$0$$$ is parallel to both sides of the board.
The area of the triangle is maximized.

Of course, he can't just be happy with finding these triangles as is. Therefore, for each digit d$$$d$$$, he's going to change the digit of exactly one cell of the board to d$$$d$$$, then find such a triangle. He changes it back to its original digit after he is done with each digit. Find the maximum area of the triangle he can make for each digit.

Note that he can put multiple vertices of the triangle on the same cell, and the triangle can be a degenerate triangle; i.e. the area of the triangle can be 0$$$0$$$. Also, note that he is allowed to change the digit of a cell from d$$$d$$$ to d$$$d$$$.
input: Each test contains one or more test cases. The first line contains the number of test cases t$$$t$$$ (1≤t≤1000$$$1 \le t \le 1000$$$).
The first line of each test case contains one integer n$$$n$$$ (1≤n≤2000$$$1 \le n \le 2000$$$) — the number of rows and columns of the board.

The next n$$$n$$$ lines of each test case each contain a string of n$$$n$$$ digits without spaces. The j$$$j$$$-th digit of the i$$$i$$$-th line is the digit of the cell at (i,j)$$$(i, j)$$$. Each digit is one of the characters from 0$$$0$$$ to 9$$$9$$$.
It is guaranteed that the sum of n2$$$n^2$$$ in all test cases doesn't exceed 4⋅106$$$4 \cdot 10^6$$$.
output: For each test case, print one line with 10$$$10$$$ integers. The i$$$i$$$-th integer is the maximum area of triangle Gildong can make when d=i−1$$$d = i-1$$$, multiplied by 2$$$2$$$.
note: In the first case, for d=0$$$d=0$$$, no matter which cell he chooses to use, the triangle with vertices at (1,1)$$$(1, 1)$$$, (1,3)$$$(1, 3)$$$, and (3,1)$$$(3, 1)$$$ is the biggest triangle with area of 2⋅22=2$$$\cfrac{2 \cdot 2}{2} = 2$$$. Since we should print it multiplied by 2$$$2$$$, the answer for d=0$$$d=0$$$ is 4$$$4$$$.
For d=1$$$d=1$$$, Gildong can change the digit of the cell at (1,3)$$$(1, 3)$$$ into 1$$$1$$$, making a triangle with vertices on all three 1$$$1$$$'s that has an area of 2$$$2$$$.

For d=2$$$d=2$$$, Gildong can change the digit of one of the following six cells into 2$$$2$$$ to make a triangle with an area of 12$$$\cfrac{1}{2}$$$: (1,1)$$$(1, 1)$$$, (1,2)$$$(1, 2)$$$, (1,3)$$$(1, 3)$$$, (3,1)$$$(3, 1)$$$, (3,2)$$$(3, 2)$$$, and (3,3)$$$(3, 3)$$$.

For the remaining digits (from 3$$$3$$$ to 9$$$9$$$), the cell Gildong chooses to change will be the only cell that contains that digit. Therefore the triangle will always be a degenerate triangle with an area of 0$$$0$$$.

In the third case, for d=4$$$d=4$$$, note that the triangle will be bigger than the answer if Gildong changes the digit of the cell at (1,4)$$$(1, 4)$$$ and use it along with the cells at (2,1)$$$(2, 1)$$$ and (4,3)$$$(4, 3)$$$, but this is invalid because it violates the condition that at least one side of the triangle must be parallel to one of the sides of the board.

legend.ai: Gildong 有一块正方形棋盘，由 n$$$n$$$ 行、n$$$n$$$ 列的方格组成，每个方格中包含一个数字(从 0$$$0$$$ 到 9$$$9$$$ 的单个数字)。第 i$$$i$$$ 行第 j$$$j$$$ 列的方格可以表示为 (i,j)$$$(i, j)$$$，且每个方格的边长为 1$$$1$$$。Gildong 喜欢大的东西，因此对于每个数字 d$$$d$$$，他想找到一个三角形，使得：
三角形的每个顶点都位于某个单元格的中心。
三角形每个顶点所在单元格的数字都是 d$$$d$$$。
三角形至少有一条边平行于棋盘的一条边。可以假设长度为 0$$$0$$$ 的边同时平行于棋盘的两条边。
当然，他不能只满足于直接找到这些三角形。因此，对于每个数字 d$$$d$$$，他会将棋盘上恰好一个单元格的数字改为 d$$$d$$$，然后寻找这样的一个三角形。处理完每个数字后，他会将该单元格改回原来的数字。求对于每个数字，他能够构造出的三角形的最大面积。
注意，他可以将三角形的多个顶点放在同一个单元格中，并且三角形可以是退化三角形；也就是说，三角形的面积可以为 0$$$0$$$。此外，注意他可以将一个单元格的数字从 d$$$d$$$ 改为 d$$$d$$$。

input.ai: 每个测试包含一个或多个测试用例。第一行包含测试用例的数量 t$$$t$$$(1≤t≤1000$$$1 \le t \le 1000$$$)。
每个测试用例的第一行包含一个整数 n$$$n$$$(1≤n≤2000$$$1 \le n \le 2000$$$)——棋盘的行数和列数。
每个测试用例接下来的 n$$$n$$$ 行中，每行都包含一个由 n$$$n$$$ 个数字组成且不含空格的字符串。第 i$$$i$$$ 行的第 j$$$j$$$ 个数字是位于 (i,j)$$$(i, j)$$$ 的单元格中的数字。每个数字都是字符 0$$$0$$$ 到 9$$$9$$$ 中的一个。
保证所有测试用例中 n2$$$n^2$$$ 的总和不超过 4⋅106$$$4 \cdot 10^6$$$。

output.ai: 对于每个测试用例，输出一行包含 10$$$10$$$ 个整数。第 i$$$i$$$ 个整数是 Gildong 在 d=i−1$$$d = i-1$$$ 时能够构成的三角形的最大面积乘以 2$$$2$$$ 的结果。

note.ai: 对于 d=1$$$d=1$$$，Gildong 可以将位于 (1,3)$$$(1, 3)$$$ 的格子中的数字改为 1$$$1$$$，从而以所有三个 1$$$1$$$ 所在的位置为顶点组成一个面积为 2$$$2$$$ 的三角形。
对于剩余的数字(从 3$$$3$$$ 到 9$$$9$$$)，Gildong 选择修改的格子将是唯一包含该数字的格子。因此，三角形始终会是一个面积为 0$$$0$$$ 的退化三角形。
在第三种情况下，对于 d=4$$$d=4$$$，注意，如果 Gildong 修改 (1,4)$$$(1, 4)$$$ 处格子中的数字，并将其与 (2,1)$$$(2, 1)$$$ 和 (4,3)$$$(4, 3)$$$ 处的格子一起使用，那么三角形的面积会大于答案，但这是无效的，因为它违反了三角形至少有一条边必须平行于棋盘某条边的条件。
